mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: In addition, NVIDIA announced that NVIDIA Halos — a full-stack, comprehensive safety system that unifies hardware architecture, AI models, software, tools and services — now expands to robotics, promoting safety across the entire development lifecycle of AI-driven robots .

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Arcbest, Advantech, Bluewhite , Boston Dynamics, FORT, Inxpect, KION, NexCobot — a NEXCOM company, and Synapticon are among the first robotics companies to join the Halos Inspection Lab, ensuring their products meet NVIDIA safety and cybersecurity requirements.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Agile Robots is post-training the GR00T N1 model in Isaac Lab to train its dual-arm manipulator robots, which run on NVIDIA Jetson hardware, to execute a variety of tasks in industrial environments.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Meanwhile, idealworks has adopted the Mega NVIDIA Omniverse Blueprint for robotic fleet simulation to extend the blueprint’s capabilities to humanoids. Building on the VDA 5050 framework, idealworks contributes to the development of guidance that supports tasks uniquely enabled by humanoid robots , such as picking, moving and placing objects.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Neura Robotics is integrating NVIDIA Isaac to further enhance its robot development workflows. The company is using GR00T-Mimic to post-train the Isaac GR00T N1 robot foundation model for its service robot MiPA . Neura is also collaborating with SAP and NVIDIA to integrate SAP’s Joule agents with its robots, using the Mega NVIDIA Omniverse Blueprint to simulate and refine robot behavior in complex, realistic operational scenarios before deployment.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Humanoid is using NVIDIA’s full robotics stack, including Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, to cut its prototyping time down by six weeks. The company is training its vision language action models on NVIDIA DGX B200 systems to boost the cognitive abilities of its robots, allowing them to operate autonomously in complex environments using Jetson Thor onboard computing.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Universal Robots is introducing UR15, its fastest collaborative robot yet, to the European market. Using UR’s AI Accelerator — developed on NVIDIA Isaac’s CUDA-accelerated libraries and AI models, as well as NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin — manufacturers can build AI applications to embed intelligence into the company’s new cobots.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Wandelbots is showcasing its NOVA Operating System, now integrated with Omniverse, to simulate, validate and optimize robotic behaviors virtually before deploying them to physical robots. Wandelbots also announced a collaboration with EY and EDAG to offer manufacturers a scalable automation platform on Omniverse that speeds up the transition from proof of concept to full-scale deployment.

mentions.access_constraints: public no-login Internet Archive replay; original publisher copyright retained; no republication grant inferred
mentions.context_excerpt: Extend Robotics is using the Isaac GR00T platform to enable customers to control and train robots for industrial tasks like visual inspection and handling radioactive materials. The company’s Advanced Mechanics Assistance System lets users collect demonstration data and generate diverse synthetic datasets with NVIDIA GR00T-Mimic and GR00T-Gen to train the GR00T N1 foundation model.
